- Wireshark 3.4.16 Release Notes
+ Wireshark 3.4.17 Release Notes
 
   This is expected to be the final release of the 3.4 branch.
 
@@ -13,30 +13,8 @@
 
    The following vulnerabilities have been fixed:
 
-     • wnpa-sec-2022-06[1] F5 Ethernet Trailer dissector infinite loop.
-       Issue 18307[2].
-
    The following bugs have been fixed:
 
-     • USB Truncation of URB_isochronous in frames Issue 18021[3].
-
-     • IPX/IPX RIP: Crash on expand subtree Issue 18234[4].
-
-     • Qt: A file or packet comment that is too large will corrupt the
-       pcapng file Issue 18235[5].
-
-     • Wrong interpretation of the cbsp.rep_period field in
-       epan/dissectors/packet-gsm_cbsp.c Issue 18254[6].
-
-     • Assertion due to incorrect mask for btatt.battery_power_state.*
-       Issue 18267[7].
-
-     • Qt: Expert Info dialog not showing Malformed Frame when Frame
-       length is less than captured length Issue 18312[8].
-
-     • Wireshark and tshark become non-responsive when reading certain
-       packets Issue 18313[9].
-
   New and Updated Features
 
   New Protocol Support
@@ -45,12 +23,9 @@
